_note: Tech tree (SPEC §14). Effect sizes are placeholders. A node costs its tier in points; a tier opens when gate_share of the previous tier's branch nodes are bought (terrain nodes don't count). Terrain nodes: units native to the terrain (sheet terrain) get +level to STR, INT, PDEF and MDEF, where level is the highest tier bought for that terrain.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.text: +10% PDEF and MDEF for front-row units.

drill.name: Drill
drill.text: Stage 3+ units with a Melee attack get +1 attack.

volley.name: Volley
volley.text: Archers split single shots across 2 targets at 60% each.

field_medicine.name: Field Medicine
field_medicine.text: Squads heal 10% of max HP after each battle.

elemental_focus.name: Elemental Focus
elemental_focus.text: +15% damage for magic and breath attacks that carry an element.

mage_regiments.name: Mage Regiments
mage_regiments.text: Casters (Magic attack) don't slow their squad.

archmagi.name: Archmagi
archmagi.text: Casters' single-target Magic attacks hit the whole row.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: Mounted units strike first in round 1 when attacking on plains.

outriders.name: Outriders
outriders.text: +1 sight for squads with mounted units.

lance_rush.name: Lance Rush
lance_rush.text: Charge works on any terrain that isn't hard (difficulty 3).

pack_bond.name: Pack Bond
pack_bond.text: Large units +10% PDEF and MDEF when two share a squad.

sky_lords.name: Sky Lords
sky_lords.text: Flying squads move one speed tier faster.
